meta.name: what-the
meta.description: What the? Use when the user wants a plain-English breakdown of something technical — the who, what, where, why, and when.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用大白话解释任何技术概念
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果常需要向非技术人员解释技术概念
copy.tagline_en: Explain any technical concept in plain English
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to explain technical concepts to non-technical people

howto.what: 把技术话题拆成“谁、什么、哪里、为什么、何时”五个方面，用大白话逐项解释，让不懂技术的人也能看懂。
howto.when: 当用户说某样东西太技术、想要通俗易懂的解释时触发，例如请求“用大白话讲一下这个”。
howto.what_en: Breaks a technical topic into who, what, where, why, and when, explaining each point in plain language so non-technical people can follow.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user says something sounds too technical and wants a plain-English explanation, such as asking for a layperson breakdown.

say_en.text: That sounds mad technical. Explain the who, what, where, why, and when of this.
say_en.note: Claude responds with a five-W breakdown.

say_en.text: Give me a simple rundown of this tool—who made it, what it does, where it's used, and why/when.
